tutorial.basics.title: Roles, production and trade
tutorial.basics.description: Choose a role, produce goods and sell them. See how unchosen roles gain coins.
tutorial.basics.role.title: Choose the Craftsman
tutorial.basics.role.text: The Craftsman has two coins from earlier rounds. Choose it to collect them and start production for everyone.
tutorial.basics.role.hint: Choose Craftsman in the role list.
tutorial.basics.produce.title: Produce your goods
tutorial.basics.produce.text: Your staffed corn plantation needs no building. Fruit needs both a staffed plantation and a staffed fruit depot. Produce one of each.
tutorial.basics.produce.hint: Confirm one corn and one fruit.
tutorial.basics.bonus.title: Take your privilege
tutorial.basics.bonus.text: As the Craftsman, take one extra good of a type you produced. Choose fruit. Then the round ends: each unchosen role gains one coin.
tutorial.basics.bonus.hint: Choose fruit as your extra good.
tutorial.basics.sell.title: Sell a fruit
tutorial.basics.sell.text: An opponent chose Trader, so you can also sell. Sell one fruit for one coin. Only the player who chose Trader gets its extra-coin privilege.
tutorial.basics.complete.title: Your economy is working
tutorial.basics.complete.text: A full city (12 spaces) or an empty victory-point supply ends the game after the current round. Add your point tokens, printed building points and occupied buildings’ endgame bonuses. Most points wins.
tutorial.shipping.title: Shipping and storage
tutorial.shipping.description: Load matching ships, earn points and keep only what your storage allows.
tutorial.shipping.role.title: Choose the Captain
tutorial.shipping.role.text: You have three fruit and two coffee. The ships already carry fruit, sugar and tobacco. Choose Captain to begin shipping.
tutorial.shipping.role.hint: Choose Captain in the role list.
tutorial.shipping.load.title: Load the matching ship
tutorial.shipping.load.text: Each ship holds one type; a type cannot occupy two public ships. Shipping is mandatory when possible, using a ship that takes the most of your chosen good. Load fruit onto the fruit ship.
tutorial.shipping.load.hint: Select fruit on the four-slot ship. It has room for two.
tutorial.shipping.pass.title: No more room
tutorial.shipping.pass.text: The fruit ship is full. Coffee cannot share a ship with sugar or tobacco. Now no ship can accept your goods, so you may pass.
tutorial.shipping.store.title: Keep one good
tutorial.shipping.store.text: Without storage buildings, keep one good in total. Keep one coffee and discard the remaining coffee and fruit.
tutorial.shipping.store.hint: Set coffee to one and every other good to zero, then confirm.
tutorial.shipping.complete.title: Ships and storage follow different rules
tutorial.shipping.complete.text: You earned points by shipping. At phase end full ships return their cargo to the supply; partial ships keep it. Your default storage kept one coffee.
tutorial.citizens.title: Workers and citizens
tutorial.citizens.description: Place citizens where their special building effects matter.
tutorial.citizens.assign.title: Choose who works where
tutorial.citizens.assign.text: Workers and citizens produce equally. Put your citizens in the Chapel and Notary, and workers on corn, fruit and the fruit depot. Citizens also score one point each at game end, even in reserve.
tutorial.citizens.assign.hint: Chapel and Notary: one citizen each. Both plantations and the fruit depot: one worker each.
tutorial.citizens.produce.title: The Chapel rewards its occupant
tutorial.citizens.produce.text: An opponent chose Craftsman. Produce one corn and one fruit. Your citizen in the Chapel also earns one victory point; a worker there would earn one coin.
tutorial.citizens.produce.hint: Confirm one corn and one fruit; the Chapel point is automatic.
tutorial.citizens.build.title: Use the Notary discount
tutorial.citizens.build.text: An opponent chose Builder. Your citizen in the Notary discounts expanded buildings by two coins. Buy City Hall for eight. A worker in the Notary would instead discount regular buildings by one.
tutorial.citizens.build.hint: Choose City Hall. Its discounted cost is eight coins.
tutorial.citizens.complete.title: Citizens are not always the best worker
tutorial.citizens.complete.text: Their placement changes some building effects. Choose between coins, points and different discounts according to your plans.
tutorial.coffee.title: Free the coffee supply
tutorial.coffee.description: Solve a coffee shortage using the Smuggler and a Festival objective.
tutorial.coffee.role.title: Find the missing coffee
tutorial.coffee.role.text: All nine coffee crates are tied up: four on Festival objectives and five on the six-slot ship. That partial ship cannot leave. Choose Smuggler to free some coffee.
tutorial.coffee.role.hint: Look at the locked Festival markers and the ship, then choose Smuggler.
tutorial.coffee.raid.title: Raid the partial ship
tutorial.coffee.raid.text: Raid the coffee ship and take three coffee. The other two return to the common supply, and the ship becomes empty.
tutorial.coffee.raid.hint: Raid the six-slot coffee ship; take three crates.
tutorial.coffee.produce.title: Complete the Carnival Cocktail
tutorial.coffee.produce.text: An opponent chose Craftsman. Produce two coffee and one corn to complete Carnival Cocktail. Its locked markers return to the supply, separate from your three-coin reward.
tutorial.coffee.produce.hint: Confirm two coffee and one corn. The other goods stay at zero.
tutorial.coffee.complete.title: Coffee is circulating again
tutorial.coffee.complete.text: The raid freed two coffee for production. Completing the objective released two more. The coffee ship is empty, and more crates can now circulate toward the remaining objectives.
tutorial.error.move: Use the move described in this step. Open Hint if you need help.
tutorial.guide.unsaved: Progress is not saved on this browser
tutorial.basics.intro.title: Build your island
tutorial.basics.intro.text: Earn the most points by shipping goods and building your city. Planter adds plantations, Builder buys buildings, and Recruiter assigns workers. This island is already staffed: start by producing.
tutorial.basics.round.title: A round of roles
tutorial.basics.round.text: The Governor chooses a role first. For most roles, everyone takes the action, starting with its chooser, who also gets a privilege. Then the next player chooses another role. Once everyone has chosen, put one coin on each unused role (except Smuggler) and pass the Governor to the next player.
